text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, the day of the Yasuda<n>Kinen arrives
accompanied by sheets<n>of heavy rain.

With the track in disarray, the<n>spectators air their
concerns—perhaps<n>even a runner like Taiki Shuttle
will<n>struggle to win in these conditions.

However, Taiki sets her fighting spirit<n>aflame,
refusing to give in to the rain.

Taking the bad weather in stride,<n>she's ready to
thrill the crowd with a<n>powerful performance!
